pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Hedgehog, Flexible Formation, 11.e4 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 through the f3-knight. Rewrote plan 1 around Bb2, Qe3, Nd4 and a later h3/g4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Mutual Double Fianchetto
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Black meet d4 with ...exd4 (no e5-pawn); plan 4 proposed Bxg7 with the c3-knight blocking the b2-bishop. Rewrote plans 3-4. Reviewer rejection (e3 lets the e-pawn recapture, not a piece) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 3...a6
pages.notes: Plan 4 read Nb5 as a Black move. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 3...g6
pages.notes: Overview called a Benoni structure a reversed Benoni; plan 1 played Be2 and O-O through the e2-pawn; plan 3 pushed f2-f4 through the f3-knight. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 3...g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed a central e5 push for White with the pawn on e2; plan 3 was a vague 'classic kingside attack'. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 4...b6
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote castling as 0-0 and Be2 through the e2-pawn; plan 2 said Nc3 supports the d4-knight. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 4...g6
pages.notes: Plan 2 named a d4-pawn where White's knight stands. Fixed plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 4...g6
pages.notes: Plan 2 proposed a3/b4, not a Maroczy plan; plan 3 prepared ...d5 with ...Rb8; plan 4 rerouted a knight via d7 to b6. Rewrote plans 2-4 around the standard Maroczy ideas.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.g3 d5 6.Bg2 e5 7.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via e1 with the king there; plan 4 put the light-squared bishop on e7. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. Reviewer rejection (Nf3 and the c4-pawn block the g2-bishop and a b3-queen from d5) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.g3 Qc7
pages.notes: Plan 1 offered Nc3 as a defence of c4; plan 3 described exd5 and Nxd5 with no e-pawn or d5-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.
